subject: watermill
name: 水车小屋
label: 大水轮小屋
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Standalone original picture-book beginner reference for children's drawing practice. ONE square PNG. One tiny watermill house, straight-on side elevation. A plain rectangular white wall, one triangular roof with NO tiles, one open arched door, one small round window, one large waterwheel beside the house consisting of a circle, a central hub and ONLY FOUR spokes. One short water curve below the wheel. Only about ten important contour shapes in total. No masonry, planks, grain, shrubs, roof texture or extra buildings. Elegant confident dark ink outlines ONLY, generous white empty interiors and a PURE WHITE background. Flat contour artwork, absolutely no shading or grayscale modeling. Complete subject centered, with generous clear margin on every side. No text, watermark, border or collage. Make the structure legible and delightful to trace.
